notes.subject: הערקים
notes.rationale: Root ערק: 'ba kgweditše' (they gnaw, ASV/JPS) kgahlanong le 'ba bakilego' (they flee, KJV/BSB 'fleeing into the wilderness') — dikgopolo tše pedi tša mooté go tšwa lemma e tee.

notes.subject: שואה / ומשאה
notes.rationale: Mantšu a mabedi a swago kudu (shoah / meshoah) — modumo o talaletšego wa tshenyo; phapano ye e nyametše phetolelong ya Sepedi ka 'tshenyo' le 'pshudulelo'.

translation: Ka tlhaele le hara ba dikgapetla, ba kgweditše lefase le omilego; maabane e be e le tshenyo le pshudulelo.
